explication: Nmap is a network discovery and security-scanning suite, with Zenmap as its graphical front end. The principal workflow takes a user’s scan request, identifies targets, probes hosts and ports, interprets responses, and presents results. The repository also contains OS fingerprinting, service detection, traceroute, scripting, packet utilities, and the separate Nping probe tool. The graph combines README-documented capabilities with relationships visible in the supplied excerpts and SOURCE INDEX; dashed, uncited links mark workflow connections whose implementation was not sampled.
